name: The Coastal Menace
summary: Captain Grayson's ghost watches Westfall's rocky coast, where his ship broke on the rocks. He blames Old Murk-Eye for driving the lighthouse keeper's family from their post, then killing them in a later attack. Now he calls on travelers to hunt the murloc chieftain and bring justice to the shore.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Dark
sections.body: The Westfall Lighthouse once guided ships through the southern coast's jagged shallows. Captain Grayson's vessel struck the rocks in the dark after murlocs frightened the lighthouse keeper's family into leaving their post. The family returned and lit the flame again, but safety did not last. A cunning, ruthless predator still stalked the shore.

sections.title: The Scourge of the Coast
sections.body: Old Murk-Eye rallied the weaker-minded murlocs along the coast and led them against the lighthouse. The second attack killed the keeper's family while Captain Grayson watched, helpless. Now the ghostly captain calls for Murk-Eye's death and a scale as proof, hoping to bring peace to the dead and protect sailors on the Great Sea.

faq.answer: Old Murk-Eye is a cunning murloc chieftain who prowls Westfall's southern coast. He rallies other murlocs and leads them in attacks on human settlements along the shore.

faq.q: Why does Captain Grayson want Old Murk-Eye dead?
faq.answer: Captain Grayson wants Old Murk-Eye dead because murlocs frightened the lighthouse keeper's family from their post, leaving the shore dark when Grayson's ship struck the rocks. Later, Grayson watched Murk-Eye lead a second attack that killed the returned keeper and his family.

faq.q: Where can Old Murk-Eye be found?
faq.answer: Old Murk-Eye prowls Westfall's open beaches and shallows, near the Westfall Lighthouse and nearby murloc encampments.

faq.q: What proof does Grayson ask for?
faq.answer: Captain Grayson asks for one scale from Old Murk-Eye as proof that the chieftain is dead.

faq.q: Who was Captain Grayson in life?
faq.answer: Captain Grayson was a sea captain whose ship struck the rocks below the Westfall Lighthouse. His spirit remains near the shore, seeking retribution against the murlocs and safer waters for passing vessels.

faq.q: What happened to the lighthouse keeper's family?
faq.answer: The lighthouse keeper's family first fled after Old Murk-Eye harassed the tower. They returned to relight the lantern, but Murk-Eye led a second attack that killed the whole family.

angles.text: Westfall's coastal waters carry vital shipping for Stormwind. Driving away leaders like Old Murk-Eye helps keep the southern sea routes safe from sabotage.
As a human, the lighthouse keeper's family's murder is a grim chapter in Westfall's loss of safety. Their deaths give you another reason to avenge your fellow citizens.
